title: Cartilage
description: A named cartilaginous structure: articular (hyaline) cartilage coating a joint surface, fibrocartilage (menisci, intervertebral discs, labra, symphyses), costal cartilage bridging rib to sternum, or other named hyaline/elastic cartilage (nasal septum, ear, laryngeal skeleton). Structures with documented distinct sub-regions (a meniscus's horns+body, an intervertebral disc's anulus fibrosus+nucleus pulposus, a labrum's quadrants) are decomposed into parts[], the same 'one-or-more functionally distinct pieces per named structure' convention used by muscle.schema.json's functional_compartments and ligament.schema.json's bands.

cartilage_type.description: articular_hyaline: thin coating on a synovial joint's bearing surface; fibrocartilage: load-bearing structures with dense collagen (menisci, discs, labra, symphyses); costal_hyaline: the rib-to-sternum cartilage rods; elastic_cartilage: pinna, epiglottis, and similar structures needing flexible recoil; growth_plate_physis: an epiphyseal plate (retained here for completeness even though it ossifies with skeletal maturity).

joint.description: id of the joint (schema/joint.schema.json) this structure is part of, for articular cartilage, menisci, labra, discs and symphyses that live inside/at a specific named joint.

parent_bone.description: for cartilage that is a surface coating or an extension of a single bone (articular cartilage on one condyle; a costal cartilage's bone-continuous end), the bone id it is rigidly attached to/continuous with.

attachments.description: for cartilage that itself bridges two bones (costal cartilage rib<->sternum; pubic symphysis's interpubic fibrocartilaginous disc hip_bone_l<->hip_bone_r) rather than merely coating or living within one joint.

typical_thickness_mm.description: representative typical thickness for articular cartilage / discs, per docs/SOURCES.md's representative-vs-exact-values policy.

parts.description: Anatomically/functionally distinct sub-regions of this one named structure. A structure with no meaningful internal subdivision still gets exactly one parts[] entry.

attachment_or_location.description: e.g. a meniscal horn's tibial attachment, a disc's anulus vs. nucleus, a labral quadrant
